note: Every external figure used in the YCM synopsis document. A figure that is not in this file may not appear in the PDF. Each entry records the publisher, the document, the URL and the date the figure was retrieved, so a reader can check it rather than trust it.

sources.title: Annual Crime Brief 2025
sources.verifiedBy: Project owner, externally, against the published brief.

figures.claim: Shop theft cases fell to 4,109 in 2025.
Shop theft cases stood at 4,237 in 2024.
Shop theft fell by approximately 3 per cent year on year.
figures.note: 4,109 against 4,237 is a fall of 128 cases, or 3.0 per cent.

figures.claim: Shop theft accounted for 19.7 per cent of total physical crime cases in 2025.
figures.warning: This is shop theft as a share of ALL physical crime. It is not a youth figure and must never be placed where it can be read as one.

figures.claim: Total physical crime cases stood at 20,857 in 2025.
Total physical crime cases stood at 19,969 in 2024.
Total physical crime rose by 4.4 per cent year on year.
More than 1,100 retail outlets had signed up to the Shop Theft Awareness for Retailers (STAR) programme as at 31 December 2025.
figures.note: SPF attributes part of the fall in shop theft to this retailer-side programme.

figures.claim: Shop theft remained one of the top offences committed by youths arrested in 2025.
figures.warning: Stated qualitatively because that is how the brief supports it. Do not attach a percentage to this claim.

sources.title: Youth advisory, ages 13 to 19
sources.usedFor: The factual spine of the Prevention Thread "The favour": never share login details or let others use your accounts.

sources.title: Wouters et al. (2013), A meta-analysis of the cognitive and motivational effects of serious games, 105(2): 249-265
sources.usedFor: Learning effect d = 0.29, no motivational advantage over ordinary instruction, and the multiple-sessions and group-play moderators that Prevention Threads and Crew Shift are built on.

sources.title: Pennycook et al. (2020), The implied truth effect
sources.usedFor: Why a provenance declaration must be exhaustive for a screen: warning a subset raises the perceived accuracy of whatever is left unwarned.

prohibited: No figure in this file may be presented as a SIDEQUEST pilot result. Nothing has been piloted and no participant data exists.
No entry in this file implies a partnership. SPF, NCPC and every retailer named in the prototype are sources or potential partners only.
